dedupe_keys.name: consumi energetici del settore pubblico illuminazione pubblica

description: The Municipality of Lecce provides electricity consumption for public-lighting installations from 2006 to 2012. Its description distinguishes low-voltage and medium-voltage supplies, labelled B.T. and M.T. A CSV distribution is listed in the municipal open-data catalogue. The observations describe electricity demand for an identified public-space infrastructure service and can provide historical inputs to supply and lighting-capacity planning. They do not establish the power rating or operating schedule of individual lamps. Consumption units and the full table schema are not specified in the inspected metadata. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution; no licence version is stated. The saved distribution is a legacy shortened link, so the native metadata API is retained as the verified route to its current catalogue entry. A related active record covers Lecce lighting consumption in March 2018 to March 2019. The different periods remain separate, and continuity of definitions between them has not been demonstrated.
